data.body_html:
Combine a luxury motor yacht, a jet ski, snorkel gear, and a paddleboard into one seamless family day on the Costa del Sol. The Family Boat Day: Jet Ski, Snorkel & Paddleboard Combo departs from Puerto Banús on the 12.5-metre Astondoa 40, accommodating up to nine passengers. At €2,299 for eight hours, the price includes a licensed skipper, fuel, soft drinks, beer, cava, white wine, light snacks, insurance, and Spanish VAT. No hidden extras. Just pick a cove, jump in, and let the kids explore while you relax.

What Makes This Combo Family-Focused?

This isn't a generic boat rental. You get three water toys included in the charter: a jet ski for speed runs, snorkel masks and fins for underwater exploration, and a paddleboard for gentle cruising along the shoreline. The Astondoa 40's wide cockpit and sunpad give everyone room to spread out. The skipper handles navigation and safety, so parents can actually switch off. Typical water temperatures in Marbella reach 24°C in summer, making snorkelling comfortable for all ages.

  • Jet ski included – no extra fees or deposit
  • Snorkel masks and fins for up to 9 people
  • Paddleboard with pump and leash
  • Licensed skipper ensures safe operation
  • All safety equipment and insurance covered

Your 8-Hour Itinerary from Puerto Banús

Depart from Puerto Banús marina at 10:00. The skipper will suggest a route based on wind and swell. Popular stops include Cala del Faro (15 minutes east), Cala Cortés (25 minutes west), or the Cabopino sand dunes. Each spot offers calm, clear water ideal for snorkelling and paddleboarding. You'll anchor for 2–3 hours per stop, with lunch served onboard. The jet ski can be used in short sessions under the skipper's watch. Return to port by 18:00.

Boat Specs: Astondoa 40

Length12.5 metres
Beam3.8 metres
EngineVolvo Penta D6 370 hp
Max passengers9
DepartsPuerto Banús
Price (8h)€2,299 all-inclusive

What's Included in the Price

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The jet ski, snorkel gear, and paddleboard are included at no extra cost. You don't pay for anything once onboard – just bring swimwear, sunscreen, and a towel.

How to Book This Combo

Visit our Boat Rental Marbella homepage to see availability. Use the WhatsApp button to confirm your date and group size. We recommend booking at least one week ahead during July and August. A 30% deposit secures the charter; the balance is due 48 hours before departure. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the trip.

Alternative Boats for Larger Groups

If your family exceeds 9 people, consider the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax). Both depart from Puerto Banús. Pricing is on request via WhatsApp – the jet ski combo can be added to these yachts for an extra charge.

Local Highlights Near Marbella

The coastline between Estepona and Cabopino offers dozens of hidden coves. Cala del Faro is a sheltered bay with rocky outcrops and clear water – perfect for snorkelling. Cala Cortés has a small sandy beach and shallow waters for kids. Cabopino features dunes and a protected nature reserve. Your skipper knows the best spots based on the day's conditions.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is included in the family boat day price?

The 8-hour charter costs €2,299 and includes a licensed skipper, fuel, jet ski, snorkel gear, paddleboard, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA. No hidden fees.

How many people can join the family boat day?

The Astondoa 40 accommodates up to 9 passengers. For larger groups, consider the Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax) or Mangusta 80 (12 pax) – pricing on request via WhatsApp.

Do we need a license to drive the jet ski?

No. The jet ski is operated under the supervision of our licensed skipper. You and your family can enjoy riding without needing any personal license.

Where do we depart from?

All charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. The marina is easily reachable by car or taxi from Marbella centre, the Golden Mile, and Estepona.

Can we choose the itinerary?

Yes. The skipper will discuss your preferences before departure. Popular stops include Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, and the Cabopino sand dunes. You can also anchor near the Marbella coast.

What happens in bad weather?

Safety comes first. If conditions are unsafe, we offer free rescheduling or a full refund. Our team monitors forecasts and will advise you 24 hours before departure.

What should we bring?

Bring swimwear, sunscreen, towels, and a camera. We provide all water toys, life jackets, and refreshments. A light jacket is useful for the afternoon breeze.

Is the boat suitable for young children?

Absolutely. The Astondoa 40 has a spacious cockpit, shaded areas, and a safe layout. Life jackets for all ages are provided. The paddleboard and snorkel gear are ideal for kids 6+.
